title: StoneDefinition
description: Two real, distinct shapes: the JDL-facing 'stone' input (backend/jewelmind/domain/schema.py::StoneSpec, whose required dimensions differ by shape for backward compatibility — see docs/bible/20-stone/576-current-round-migration.md) and the generatedMetadata a real build_stone() call actually returns on the resulting GeneratedComponent. This is documentation of an existing runtime contract, never a second canonical JDL schema — the authoritative validator remains StoneSpec/JewelryDefinition (brief section 5). See docs/bible/20-stone/562-stone-domain-model.md.

stone.description: The JDL-facing input. Mirrors StoneSpec exactly. `diameter` is meaningful only for shape="round"; `length`/`width` are required for every other shape — enforced by StoneSpec's own model_validator, deliberately not as a JSON-Schema if/then conditional here (see docs/bible/05-jdl/075-validation-pipeline.md's structural/semantic layering).

generatedMetadata.description: The metadata dict on the GeneratedComponent named 'stone_reference'. Round carries three extra round-only construction fields (girdleRadiusMm/tableRadiusMm) the non-round loft has no single equivalent for.

girdleRadiusMm.description: round only — a single girdle radius exists only for a radially symmetric outline.

girdleZMm.description: Z height of the girdle plane, the assembly's stone-placement anchor.

lengthMm.description: CONSTRUCTION_PARAMETER — the resolved major horizontal dimension used to build the geometry, never an independent re-measurement. Geometry Inspection's STONE_MEASURED_LENGTH fact is the independently measured counterpart (see docs/bible/20-stone/574-stone-inspection-contract.md).

isGemologicalReproduction.description: Always false, for every shape (STONE-GOV-011). A StoneReference is deterministic CAD reference geometry, never a claim of gemological, optical, or commercial-cut accuracy.
